title: New Hires for New York Times Cooking
body_markdown:
Laura Morell joins as a vertical video editor and Kelsie Schrader as an editorial project manager. Read more in the below note from Cooking’s Lauren Savoie and Shanice Bland.


We’re excited to share that we have two more new additions to the New York Times Cooking team: Laura Morell is coming aboard as a vertical video editor and Kelsie Schrader will join us as an editorial project manager.


Laura will be our first staff video editor focused entirely on vertical formats, working with our social team on vertical video series, recipe demos and celebrity content for publication on Cooking and our social channels. Previously, she worked at Condé Nast with the teams at Bon Appétit, Vogue and The New Yorker, shaping and editing video series, and working with analytics teams to develop social video strategy. Last year, Laura made a short film called “Airports in the 90’s,” which was stitched entirely from clips of more than 100 Hollywood movies set in airports or on planes; the film has since played at a dozen festivals.


In another newly created role, Kelsie Schrader will be our first-ever dedicated project manager for the Cooking newsroom team. She’ll develop, implement and maintain workflow and collaboration across our most visible projects, including Thanksgiving, Cookie Week and our video franchises. She comes to us from New York magazine, where she was a managing editor and oversaw editorial operations for The Strategist. A Kansas City native, Kelsie is a proud University of Missouri journalism school alum, and she long maintained a connection to her hometown by serving as Kansas City magazine’s sole copy editor.


Laura reports to Shanice, and Kelsie reports


to Lauren. Both start today. Please join us in welcoming them to The Times!


— Lauren and Shanice
